/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files -g 'package.json' -g 'pnpm-workspace.yaml' -g 'mise.toml' -g '.mise.toml' | sort && rg -n '\"test\"|device-discovery|vitest|jest' package.json client/**/package.json --glob 'package.json' 2>/dev/null || true && find client -type f \\( -name '*test.*' -o -name '*.spec.*' \\) -print | sort | head -100 && git diff -- .rsp/changes/device-discovery-boundary.md client/packages/device-discovery/src/index.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' package.json && find . -path '*/node_modules' -prune -o -type f \\( -name '*test.*' -o -name '*.spec.*' \\) -print | sort && find client/packages/device-discovery -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort && git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'CONTEXT-MAP.md' -g 'CONTEXT.md' -g 'SKILL.md' -g '.rsp/**' | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .agents/skills/rsp-review/SKILL.md && sed -n '1,260p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,260p' client/AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,260p' client/CONTEXT.md && find .rsp/focus.d -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort"
